newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: AT&T, Telia buy Argentine PCS specifications.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, Telia buy Argentine PCS specifications.

text.p: Argentina's Communications Secretariat said Thursday it has sold bid specifications to a group led by AT&T of the United States and Sweden's national telecoms group Telia for a tender of PCS licenses.
PCS refers to personal communications services, a new generation of wireless phones.

AT&T is teaming up with Argentina's multi media Grupo Clarin and two of the country's largest banks, Banco de Galicia SA and Banco Frances SA, in its bid to win the license to operate PCS networks in the local market.
Argentina's VCC communications company has also bought the specifications, the secretariat said in a statement.
Communications secretary German Kammerath said he was satisfied with the interest expressed by international companies so soon after the announcement of the tender.
The interest showed the overseas companies "are thinking about Mercosur and in the big future market in telecommunications, which is the country's second largest industry."
Mercosur is a customs union comprising Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay.
